Name: Crop Diseases
Author: s1lence17
Description:
[*][b]The Infection:[/b] Every night, growing crops have a 1% chance of being attacked by aphids.[/*]
[*][b]Dynamic Visuals:[/b] You will see an animated swarm of black insects flying over the infected plants.[/*]
[*][b]The Epidemic:[/b] Don't ignore the problem! If left untreated, the disease has a 25% chance to spread to adjacent crops the next morning.[/*]
[*][b]The Cure:[/b] Right-click the infected plant while holding Bug Meat to cure it. The plant will instantly become healthy![/*]
[*][b]Toxic Guard (NEW!):[/b] Right-click a scarecrow with Sap (x30) to protect its radius for 7 days, or Red Mushroom (x5) for 28 days. Pests will never spawn in this area.[/*]
[*][b]Iridium Power (NEW!):[/b] Toxic Guard works on the Iridium Scarecrow too, creating a massive 17-tile safe zone![/*]
[*][b]Smart UI (NEW!):[/b] Protected scarecrows emit a glowing toxic aura. Hover your mouse over them to check the remaining days of protection.[/*]
[*][b]Smart Mechanics:[/b] Aphids dry out the soil, so rain won't help. Fully grown crops and dead crops are immune.[/*]
[*][b]Safe Havens:[/b] The Greenhouse and Ginger Island are safe from pests.[/*]
[*][b]Compatibility:[/b] Fully compatible with custom crops from other mods! Fully translated into English, Russian, and Ukrainian.
